data.title: May
data.about:
May is the final phase of Emaar Properties’ most popular Arabian Ranches 3 Community. May symbolizes community-focused, nature-connected living, allowing you to experience a unique combination of modern living and convenience in Arabian Ranches 3.

May at Arabian Ranches 3 has elegant three and four-bedroom townhouses. Each townhouse also comes with a selection of two distinct architectural styles; Aria& Iris. Residents will experience a warm atmosphere and a distinct sense of belonging in a tranquil refuge with breathtaking features and smart interior design. This gated community of contemporary townhouses in an exquisite suburban location provides homeowners the best of both worlds: quiet tranquillity and the urban modern vibe of the metropolis.

location_tile.title: Located on the periphery of the masterplan along Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Road
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
May is located on the outskirts of the masterplan along Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Road, with easy access to Academic Road and Emirates Road, and is adjacent to some of the city’s most famous attractions, including as Global Village, IMG Worlds of Adventure, and Dubai Outlet Mall.

  • 05 Mins from Global Village
  • 10 Mins from Dubai Polo and Equestrian Club
  • 20 Mins from Downtown Dubai
  • 20 Mins from DXB Int’ Airport
